title: Language Model Adaption for Reinforcement Learning with Natural Language Action Space
caption: Figure 1: The MIPO Framework. Embeddings produced by different encoders are concatenated into a single one and then fed into the policy and the value network. MIPO iteratively applies policy evaluation, policy improvement, and prior adaptation to achieve the monotonic improvement on the MI-regularized RL objective.
